name: paperoffice
description: Search, read and create documents in your PaperOffice account from Cursor, plus five Agent Skills (API integration, invoice extraction, OCR, documents, tool discovery). Remote MCP server, OAuth 2.1 or PaperOffice user token, EU hosted.

PAPEROFFICE_TOKEN.title: PaperOffice token
PAPEROFFICE_TOKEN.description: User or group token (po_ut_ or po_gt_) from app.paperoffice.ai. System keys (po_sk_) and publishable keys (po_pk_) are rejected by the server.
